order: Three independent model streams; within each stream repeat 1 across all scenarios, then repeat 2, then repeat 3. Maximum three concurrent requests.
errors: Keep every failed attempt and continue with the next planned slot. Do not replace failures. Token usage is unavailable for failed requests; charges may still apply.
comparison: One model proposal applied to identical initial states, with and without the independent authority check. No human review, tool loop, or real payment.
limits: Exploratory public development suite, selected models from one provider, only three repetitions per case. No held-out tasks, independent reproduction, population confidence interval, model ranking, concurrency test, or dollar-cost estimate. Intent scoring checks amount/supplier/invoice, not request ID. Model latency includes API and network time, not isolated gate overhead.
